sections.title: Charge items overview
sections.content:
## Overview

A charge item is a type of charge or surcharge used when calculating freight charges. Here you declare the item name, the company it applies to, the display flags and the required conditions.

sections.title: Creating a charge item
sections.content:
### Step 1

Go to **Freight charges** > **Configuration** > **Charge items**. The system shows the list of charge items already declared.

![Freight charges menu with Charge items open](/uploads/0166be9656142f04ecc5c3cf.png)

![Charge items list](/uploads/e3f317fed8fac7121be7b2c9.png)

### Step 2

Click **New** to open the charge item declaration screen.

![New button on the Charge items list](/uploads/d761947ebebc91ad0edbbcf9.png)

### Step 3

Fill in the charge item information.

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Item name | Name of the charge or surcharge used when calculating freight charges. |
| Company | Company the charge item applies to. |
| Show on freight charge sheet | Allows the item to appear on the freight charge sheet. |
| Show on Surcharge | Show the item in the surcharge section. |
| Show on Order Charge | Show the item in the order charge section. |
| Required Route Group | A route group must be selected when the item is applied. |
| Required Customer | A customer must be selected when the item is applied. |
| Required From Location | An origin must be declared when the item is applied. |
| Manage Pricing Engine | Allows the item to take part in the system's automatic pricing mechanism. |

![Form for the display flags and required conditions of a charge item](/uploads/c55f812c231716d5eae84d7e.png)

sections.title: Declaring Items
sections.content:
In the **Item** section, click **Add a line** to declare the detailed charge components required by your business.

![Item area and the Add a line button for declaring charge components](/uploads/47920dd3dc005ade8d9ba259.png)

sections.title: Saving the charge item
sections.content:
Review all the configuration, then click **Save manually** to record the charge item in the system.

![Charge item form filled in, before saving](/uploads/0c5f692f45215568991637ef.png)
